description: This file defines the implementation class srs_allocator_impl for managing SRS resource allocation in a 5G NR scheduler, including methods for slot indication and aperiodic SRS allocation, along with internal data structures for resource management.

classes.name: srs_allocator_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the srs_allocator interface for managing SRS resources in the scheduler.

methods.name: srs_allocator_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SRS allocator with cell configuration and optional prohibit window.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Method to indicate a slot event for SRS resource management.

methods.name: allocate_aperiodic_srs
methods.description: Allocates resources for aperiodic SRS based on cell resource and UE configuration.

methods.name: alloc_srs_resource
methods.description: Checks and allocates an SRS resource for a given slot and cell ID.

methods.name: get_slot_idx
methods.description: Returns the index of a slot within the TDD period.
